text: 长城证券公告，持股5%以上股东深圳新江南投资有限公司持有公司股份4.49亿股，占公司总股本比例11.12%，计划于2026年10月29日至2027年1月28日期间，通过集中竞价或大宗交易减持不超过6051.64万股，占公司总股本比例不超过1.5%。
text_en: Great Wall Securities announced that shareholder Shenzhen Xinjiangnan Investment Co., Ltd., which holds more than 5% of the company's shares, holds 449 million shares, accounting for 11.12% of the company's total share capital. It plans to reduce its holdings by no more than 60.5164 million shares through centralized bidding or block trades during the period from October 29, 2026 to January 28, 2027, accounting for no more than 1.5% of the company's total share capital.
